title: Morning Intel
bullets: Markets: Dow fell ~700pts (>1%), S&P 500 -0.9%, Nasdaq -1% Thu as yields and oil rose
Yields: 30-yr Treasury climbed to ~5.24-5.25% (from 5.19%) despite Bessent signaling bigger bond buybacks (>$4B/operation) to bring yields down
Oil/Gold/Crypto: Brent crude +2.4% to $93.78/bbl on Trump's threat of 'maximum economic pain' on Iran; gold +0.8% to $4,580; bitcoin roughly flat near $72,681
Companies: Walmart sank ~9% after its smallest sales gain in 6+ years amid cautious consumer spending
Companies: Moderna fell 24%, giving back part of the prior day's 177% rally on melanoma vaccine data
Companies: SpaceX shares down 4.1% after Musk said the next big Starship rocket operation is still months away
Macro: WSJ notes Treasuries are losing their 'safe haven' status as US debt hits $40 trillion
Ahead: Flash Manufacturing PMI due Fri; BJ's Wholesale and KE Holdings report earnings
